evidence.note: ManifestContext.Satisfies gates on an allow-list of shard-satisfiable risk reasons, full shard coverage, cross-shard result when multi-shard, and a PASS verdict; no way to downgrade the context-risk blocker without complete coverage.

Blocking context-risk finding retained when the manifest does not satisfy; the advisory replacement is only emitted on the satisfied path, and the truncated-diff finding is only demoted to advisory when sharded.
addedLines now prefers BranchDiffFull with a fallback to git.Diff, so lints run over the untruncated measured diff; no nil/empty hazard.

New table- and injection-driven test file covering layout, reproducibility, fence widening, atomic replace/rollback, prune, discovery, explicit results and GC, including every injected Deps failure branch. No eval, no TODO/FIXME, no truncated chunks.
awk field usage matches the Go coverprofile format ($1 file:range, $3 hit count); set -euo pipefail and a trap-cleaned temp profile; no unsafe execution.
Read rejects any name containing '/', '\\' or '.' before joining the .yaml suffix, so embedded lookup cannot be steered outside the embedded tree; errors do not leak the underlying FS error.

findings.note: manifestFound returns an empty string whenever ShardCount == 0, so the 'no shard review results were ingested' detail can never appear in the blocking context-risk finding's Found text - the case where nothing was ingested is exactly the one it was written for. Cosmetic/diagnostic only; the gate still blocks correctly.

evidence.note: early return on ShardCount == 0 precedes the !manifest.Present branch that appends the 'no shard review results were ingested' part
